## Required personal checks
- [ ] Confirm that the printed email is active and personally controlled, and is appropriate for publication.
- [ ] Confirm ORCID belongs to the author; correct/remove if not.
- [ ] Choose actual formal affiliation: independent researcher vs employer name/dept; if employment is unrelated to the paper, ensure no appearance of employer endorsement.
- [ ] Confirm whether institutional approval is required, and whether the study was performed on behalf of/using resources of an institution.
- [ ] Attest every grant, salary/equipment/time allowance, consultancy or other support relevant to the work.
- [ ] Attest financial and non-financial competing interests, including relevant public-sector employment, interests or institutional roles, per Springer Nature policy.
- [ ] Confirm single-authorship accountability and submission exclusivity/non-overlapping prior publications.
- [ ] Confirm the AI disclosure accurately describes all actual use (research search, mathematical review, code generation, drafting and editing), not merely AI-assisted copyediting.
- [ ] Approve all final title-page, supplement and cover-letter metadata together.

JE official instructions: https://link.springer.com/journal/712/submission-guidelines (checked 2026-10-29 JST). A checked box is a human assertion, not a claim that AI verified the fact. This file should remain outside the journal submission archive.
